name: sdns-transport-response-consistency-attestations
instr:
sdns cannot show that DNS responses retain consistent semantics across decoded and raw writes, normalization, framing, batching, and failures. Add optional, bounded, concurrency-safe accounting without changing delivery. Each finalized response must produce one immutable record of representation, payload size, rcode, normalization, write outcome, and network delivery, retaining no messages or bytes. Management and metrics totals must match.

Clear request-scoped evidence at reset, finish, retirement, and pool reuse. Evidence covers only its observation boundary. A BufferWriter capture, decoded directly or unpacked from raw input, belongs only to the current internal query and cannot report framing or network delivery.

Keep legacy Transport implementations compatible. `ResponseAwareTransport` in `github.com/semihalev/sdns/middleware` optionally supplies `ResponseConsistency`. Preserve identity, size, framing, malformed-input, delivery, and error behavior for raw and decoded writes across mock.Writer, BufferWriter, DoQ ResponseWriter, tcpJob, and every UDP send path.

Snapshots must be deterministic, immutable, category-bounded, and consistent with metric meanings. Disabled or omitted accounting must not affect serving or management. Enabled `MaxCategories` accepts only integers from 1 through 256; invalid values prevent startup. `Server.ResponseConsistencySnapshot` in `github.com/semihalev/sdns/server` and `API.ResponseConsistency` in `github.com/semihalev/sdns/api` expose ag
